#!/bin/sh

start_agent()
{
    LOG_FILE="/tmp/localrrm_agent_startup.log"
    RRM_NO_AUTO_STARTUP_FLAG="/configs/em_no_auto_startup_flag"
    PROC_DEP=nva

    if [ -e ${RRM_NO_AUTO_STARTUP_FLAG} ] ; then
        return
    fi

    #while [ `ps auxw | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
    while [ `busybox ps | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
        #uptime >> ${LOG_FILE} ;
        #echo ${PROC_DEP}" is not started yet" >> ${LOG_FILE} ;
        sleep 4 ;
    done &&
    echo ${PROC_DEP}" is ready, start waiting for 30 seconds" >> ${LOG_FILE} &&
    uptime >> ${LOG_FILE} &&
    sleep 30 &&
    /usr/bin/ai-agent &

    return
}

start_controller()
{
    LOG_FILE="/tmp/localrrm_controller_startup.log"
    RRM_NO_AUTO_STARTUP_FLAG="/configs/em_no_auto_startup_flag"
    PROC_DEP=ecd

    if [ -e ${RRM_NO_AUTO_STARTUP_FLAG} ] ; then
        return
    fi

    image_type=`cat /etc/buildinfo | grep UNIT_TYPE | awk -F '=' '{print $2}'`
    operatorID=`ritool get OperatorID | awk '{print $2}'`

    if [ "$image_type" == "ha0236ga" -a "$operatorID" != "0000" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    #while [ `ps auxw | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
    while [ `busybox ps | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
        #uptime >> ${LOG_FILE} ;
        #echo ${PROC_DEP}" is not started yet" >> ${LOG_FILE} ;
        sleep 4 ;
    done &&
    echo ${PROC_DEP}" is ready, start waiting for 30 seconds" >> ${LOG_FILE} &&
    uptime >> ${LOG_FILE} &&
    sleep 30 &&
    /usr/bin/ai_controller &
   
    return    
}

enable_controller()
{
    PROC_DEP=ai_controller
    RRM_AUTO_ENABLE_FLAG="/configs/localrrm_auto_enable_flag"

    if [ ! -e ${RRM_AUTO_ENABLE_FLAG} ] ; then
        return
    fi

    #while [ `ps auxw | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
    while [ `busybox ps | grep ${PROC_DEP} | grep -v grep | wc -l` -le 0 ] ; do
        sleep 3 ;
    done && sleep 15 &&
    aci enable &

    return
}

start_controller
start_agent

exit 0
